note:
Campground has waterfront tent sites, but RV sites are set back a ways from the water. --AWH
On South Bass Island: drive on by Miller Ferry from Catawba, RVs welcome, first come with no vehicle reservations, $44 each way for a 23-26 ft RV plus passenger fares (2026). Proof of accommodation is required for weekend vehicle travel, and no same-day vehicle round trips on weekends or holidays. --Claude
flags: Phone missing: (419) 285-2112 (ODNR campground and park pages; 'Park Office ... 8am to 4:30pm, Mid April to Mid October').

PIN off: 41.6427,-82.8355 is at the park's day-use shelter, 355 m from the centre of the RV sites and 265 m from the nearest. Corrected coords: 41.64523,-82.83810 (centre of the 65 RV sites' ReserveOhio coordinates).

FERRY (brief's question). Miller Ferry vehicle page: 'Cars, motorcycles, RVs, and boats on trailers are welcome'; 'Reservations are not required. Vehicles are taken on a first-come, first-served basis'; 'Proof of accommodation required for weekend vehicle travel'; 'We are unable to round trip a vehicle within the same day on Saturday, Sunday or Holidays'; leave by lining up before 6 pm (summer) or 5 pm / 4 pm Sundays and holidays (spring and fall); 'We reserve the right to limit vehicles'; 'not responsible for low hanging exhaust or low ground clearance vehicles'. Fare table 'RV and Trailer Fares - Each Way': 19-22 ft $36, 23-26 ft $44, 27-30 ft $54 (car $23, adult passenger $9 each way). The pages post NO length or height limit. Whether the $44 replaces the $23 car fare is implied, not stated ('Trailer fare is in addition to vehicle'). So a 23-ft EKKO costs about $124 round trip with two adults, on top of the site. Jet Express is passenger-only and doesn't matter here.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (stored lakeview, no waterfront_evidence in the entry). ReserveOhio's coordinates on imagery: the electric and full-hookup block sits in unbroken woods about 100-250 m back from the bluff; the closest RV pads are non-electric 126 and 129, about 50 m from the shore through trees. AWH's firsthand note says RV sites 'are set back a ways from the water'. The waterfront tent sites are tent-only. Lakeview looks generous for a 23-ft motorhome; not changed. Imagery here is autumn canopy, so views can't be ruled out either way.
Inclusion evidence is stale: it says '~125 non-electric primitive + 10 full-hookup'; the engine has 48 electric, 10 full hookup, 8 non-electric RV and 44 tent-only.
Five 'Tent Only' sites (084-086, 090, 118) carry IsRVSite true in the engine; counted as tent (their type name and $ match the tent sites).
